messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] error in recognizing chiptype
parts:
Hi,

before I start troubleshooting this, please update and try with the
latest version of aroma.affymetrix.

The "hour calculation" is probably due to the fact that it generated a
monocell CDF (this happens once; see FAQ).

For my troubleshooting it helps if you show what the intermediate
steps are/reports, i.e.

cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("paired2", cdf=cdf);
print(cs);
unit <- indexOf(cdf, "CN_816936");
str(unit);
y <- readUnits(cs,units=unit, verbose=-20) # VERBOSE

Cheers

Henrik

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: error in recognizing chiptype
parts:
Hi,

you've spotted a bug. It only occurs when you work with the full CDF
and do not have the default CDF (in the annotationData/ search path).
The bug is "friendly" in the sense that it does not generate false
estimates if you indeed had the default CDF. However, it should not
show up and I have been able to reproduce it and I've located the
problem and committed a patch. Grab the patch by doing (only needed
once):

library(aroma.affymetrix);
downloadPackagePatch("aroma.affymetrix");

Let us know if this solves your problem.

Cheers

Henrik

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: error in recognizing chiptype
parts:
The rule is that the last dimension/index (here 1:42) is always the
one corresponding to the arrays. You can get the names/fullnames of
the arrays using getNames(cs)/getFullNames(cs), and they are in that
order. [The array names are not added on purpose because the
memory/time overhead is too big].

/H
